name: us-state-tax
description: Dependency-free US state individual income tax engine for tax years 2025 and 2026, covering 25 states plus New York City and Yonkers. Models what rate tables leave out: Massachusetts, which every rate table reports as a flat 5% and which taxes short-term capital gains at 8.5% and long-term gains on collectibles at 12% on half the gain, whose No Tax Status table is generated from one constant plus the exemption schedule, whose Limited Income Credit charges 10% - double the statutory rate - across the band above it, and whose 4% surtax threshold cannot be doubled by filing separately because a couple filing a joint federal return must file jointly here; New Jersey, which has no federal starting line at all, whose filing threshold makes the first $10,000 of gross income tax-free and the next dollar cost $126, whose retirement income exclusion ends in a wall that costs a joint retiree $1,381 on one dollar at $150,000 of income, and whose thirteen published rate-schedule subtraction constants are derived here rather than transcribed; CalEITC, which is not a percentage of the federal credit but a triangle with no plateau, peaking at one dollar of earned income so a California parent faces minus 34% and plus 34% on consecutive dollars; California's Young Child Tax Credit, one credit per return rather than one per child and gated on CalEITC; New York City's 3.078%-3.876% resident tax and its 30%-to-10% sliding earned income credit; the Yonkers surcharge of 16.75% of the state tax, measured before refundable credits so it can never go negative; New York's supplemental tax, which claws back the benefit of the lower brackets; which federal figure each state starts from; which federal deductions it adds back; the state earned income credits and the three that are not what they look like; and the credit phase-outs that make Utah's and Pennsylvania's flat taxes anything but flat. Every figure cited to the statute or state release it came from, and every carried-forward figure flagged as provisional.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/finalize.mjs
